prompt_transform.guidance: For low-key or dark interiors, name the motivated source, key direction, contrast, shadow detail, and color temperature.
prompt_transform.template: Lighting: motivated low-key light in {scene}; source direction, contrast, shadow detail, and color temperature support {emotion}.

negative_constraints: Do not brighten every area when the prompt asks for darkness or restraint.
Do not add glamor highlights that conflict with realistic low light.
quality_checks: Contrast and color temperature are explicit.

source_refs.label: B&H cinematic lighting guide
source_refs.note: Motivated key, fill, backlight, and ratios shape mood.

source_refs.label: DeepMind Veo prompt guide
source_refs.note: Lighting is a core prompt element.

prompt_transform.guidance: Use key, fill, and back/rim separation when the subject must read against the set.
prompt_transform.template: Lighting: key/fill/back separation keeps {subject} readable within {scene} without flattening the mood.

negative_constraints: Do not describe all lights as equally bright unless a flat look is intended.
Do not add rim light when silhouette loss is not a problem.
quality_checks: Subject separation is solved without breaking mood.
Key and fill relationship is clear.

source_refs.label: B&H cinematic lighting guide
source_refs.note: Key, fill, and backlight have separate storytelling roles.

prompt_transform.guidance: When possible, attach light to an in-scene practical source such as window, lamp, screen, sign, candle, or doorway.
prompt_transform.template: Lighting: practical source in {scene} motivates the key light and keeps the image believable.

negative_constraints: Do not invent visible practical props that contradict the scene.
Do not use unmotivated spotlight language in naturalistic scenes.
quality_checks: The light source can exist in the scene.
Lighting supports continuity across adjacent nodes.

source_refs.label: B&H cinematic lighting guide
source_refs.note: Motivated practical light improves realism and continuity.

prompt_transform.guidance: Use color temperature to clarify time, source, mood, and contrast between character and environment.
prompt_transform.template: Lighting: color temperature supports {emotion}; avoid random color unless the style demands it.

negative_constraints: Do not combine many unrelated color palettes in one shot.
Do not let color style override character readability.
quality_checks: Color temperature is tied to source or mood.
Palette is consistent with project style.

source_refs.label: DeepMind Veo prompt guide
source_refs.note: Lighting descriptions improve control over generated shots.

prompt_transform.guidance: Make lighting mood explicit through source, contrast, direction, color, and atmosphere.
prompt_transform.template: Lighting: mood is built from motivated source, contrast, color temperature, and atmosphere for {emotion}.

negative_constraints: Do not use lighting adjectives without source or contrast.
Do not let lighting contradict the scene environment.
quality_checks: Lighting source and mood are both present.

source_refs.label: B&H cinematic lighting guide
source_refs.note: Lighting ratios and motivated sources affect dramatic mood.
